subtitle: Three songs built step by step on the M8: Low Tide, Faded Polaroid and Overpass. Firmware 6.6.3.
description: Three songs built step by step on the M8: Low Tide, Faded Polaroid and Overpass; two techniques, Tables and Sampling; and fifteen instrument patch cards to look up.
note: A book to read with the M8 in your hands. Do each song's steps in order; the patch cards at the back are for looking up. The pictures are the M8's own screens. Flats in the text are spelled with a plain b (Bbmaj9, A7b9); the pictures show the real sign. The live version, with sound, is the Methodos app.
